notes: Your own field data, checked like the office packages do. GNSS: Emlid zips and folders drop straight onto GNSS > Process; every occupation is named for its point; short occupations are processed; each baseline is graded Pass / Flag / Fail (forward and backward solutions must agree, as Leica's independent check) with every reason; the plan shows each point alone until processed, then the vectors coloured by grade. Traverse (the staff test against ProSurv): ddd.mmss recognised and said; no silent start bearing of 0 (First-leg direction, taken from control and said); the angular misclosure computed and shared before Bowditch; least squares held in orientation; direction sets and 239-54-09 angles read; Lo Y/X kept positive, directions from +X. Scan: measurements drawn on the cloud with their values; one disturbed benchmark can no longer hide a scan's offset. Surfaces: points with no height are left out and said, not contoured into cliffs.
